mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subagent_task (task_id, execution_id, agent_id, description, status, result_text, error_message, cancel_requested, started_at, completed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{executionId}, #{agentId}, #{description}, #{status}, #{result}, #{errorMessage}, #{cancelRequested}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE subagent_task SET status='RUNNING', started_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE subagent_task SET cancel_requested=1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')

UPDATE subagent_task SET status=#{status}, result_text=#{result}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, cancel_requested=#{cancelRequested}, started_at=#{startedAt}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','TIMED_OUT','CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM subagent_task WHERE task_id=#{taskId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE subagent_task SET status='FAILED', error_message='Process restarted before task completed', completed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING')
